answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 31416 Country: India Title: I want to know thestatus of my Nikah Question: me and my husband had an argument in which he said its happen like this we cant live together,after that i asked him what shall we do now he said we will take talak and he said triple talak after that i asked him what did u say he said it was not for you and he just left.then i came to my mothers place for some work.i asked him again the same question why did he say like that he said he dint mean it and it was not intentional....after somedays again iasked the same question... he changed the sentence saying that he told if u do something again we can take talak. if i say triple talaq ,talaq will get valid..please help me i want to know my status Answer ID: 31416 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 687/692/M=1432) In the case mentioned above, if you yourself have heard the words of three talaq clearly then you are asked (by Shariah) to separate yourself from your husband and let him have no control over your body. And, take this issue to any nearby Darul Qaza or Sharai Panchayat and get it solved there. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
